goal.original: Release 2.1.3 without breaking the ~3,000 users who downloaded 2.1.2.
goal.summary: Release held. Root cause of the H3 Windows error 1450 crash found: the first/last-frame graph (minimax_h3_fl2va, op i2v_ms) still has one MpiClearVram per encode (528 after 472, 527 after 485), so the 25 GB Qwen3-VL TE is evicted between the stage-1 and refine encodes and re-read from disk - the read that fails. MPI-1029 (3e7ae7dad, 2026-10-06) fixed this in r2va only. Fabio approved applying the fix to fl2va, in the RAW template too.

Proof: today's log shows 'Requested to load MiniMaxH3TEModel_' twice per fl2va prompt; every 1450 hit during a TE load
